intro.title: Form Library from Scratch
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple form library from scratch using React and JavaScript. You will learn how to create reusable form components that manage their own state and validation. The core programming concepts involved include React hooks for state management and event handling. You will work with JSX to structure your forms and handlers to process user input. By the end, you'll have a basic custom form library that can handle text inputs and submissions. This project will help you understand how form libraries work under the hood.
intro.usecase: Form libraries like Formik and React Hook Form are essential in modern web applications where user input is critical. You'll encounter them in e-commerce checkout flows, user registration forms, admin dashboards for data entry, and settings panels where validation and state management are required. As a developer, you'll need to understand these patterns when building interactive features like multi-step wizards, dynamic form fields, or complex validation logic that goes beyond basic HTML forms. Mastering form library concepts helps you create maintainable, reusable form components that handle user input reliably across your application.
